AL.name: Alabama

dept_aging.name: Alabama Department of Senior Services

property_tax.name: Homestead Exemption (age 65+)
property_tax.blurb: Total exemption from state property tax at age 65+ regardless of income; counties offer additional exemptions tied to income.

highlights: Total state property tax exemption at 65+ (no income limit).
ALABAMA Cares caregiver respite via 13 regional AAAs.
SenioRx free/low-cost prescription help.

AK.name: Alaska

dept_aging.name: Alaska Division of Senior and Disabilities Services

property_tax.name: Senior/Disabled Property Tax Exemption
property_tax.blurb: $150,000 of assessed value exempt for owners 65+. Many municipalities exempt the entire residence.

highlights: Alaska Senior Benefits cash assistance ($76–$250/month).
Permanent Fund Dividend (PFD) — annual statewide dividend regardless of age.
Choice Waiver provides home-care alternative to nursing home.

AZ.name: Arizona

dept_aging.name: Arizona Department of Economic Security — Aging & Adult Services

property_tax.name: Senior Property Valuation Protection ("Senior Freeze")
property_tax.blurb: Freezes assessed value for owners 65+ with income under $46,416 single / $58,020 couple (2026 limits, county-adjusted).

highlights: ALTCS = Arizona's Medicaid LTC — pays for nursing home, assisted living, and in-home care.
Senior Property Valuation Protection freezes assessment.
AZ SHIP through DES Aging & Adult Services.

AR.name: Arkansas

dept_aging.name: Arkansas Division of Aging, Adult, and Behavioral Health Services

property_tax.name: Homestead Property Tax Credit + Senior Freeze
property_tax.blurb: All homeowners get $425 credit; 65+ also lock in assessed value ("frozen value") regardless of future market increases.

highlights: ARChoices Medicaid waiver covers home & community-based services.
Senior assessed-value freeze at 65 — major benefit.
8 AAA regions cover all 75 counties.

CA.name: California

dept_aging.name: California Department of Aging

property_tax.name: Property Tax Postponement (PTP) + Prop 19 base-year transfer
property_tax.blurb: PTP defers property tax for owners 62+ with under $51,762 income (state pays, lien on property). Prop 19 lets owners 55+ transfer their original tax base when they sell and buy a new primary home in CA.

highlights: Medi-Cal LTC has the most generous spousal-impoverishment rules.
IHSS (In-Home Supportive Services) pays family members to provide care.
PACE programs in 30+ counties — most in the country.
CalFresh has expanded SSI/SSP integration.

CO.name: Colorado

dept_aging.name: Colorado Division of Aging and Adult Services

property_tax.name: Senior Homestead Property Tax Exemption
property_tax.blurb: 50% exemption on first $200,000 of home value for owners 65+ who've owned the home 10+ years. Funding capped — apply early in the year.

highlights: Old Age Pension (OAP) — state cash supplement for seniors with very low income.
Colorado PEAK portal screens for Medicaid + SNAP + LIHEAP in one application.
Senior homestead exemption (50% of first $200K).

CT.name: Connecticut

dept_aging.name: Connecticut Department of Aging and Disability Services

property_tax.name: Circuit Breaker + Local Option Senior Freeze
property_tax.blurb: State Circuit Breaker gives up to $1,250 property tax credit for income-eligible owners 65+. Many towns add local senior freezes on top.

highlights: CT generous Medicare Savings Program limits — among the highest in the country.
ConnPACE drug assistance + integration with Extra Help.
CHCPE (CT Home Care Program for Elders) waiver.

DE.name: Delaware

dept_aging.name: Delaware Division of Services for Aging and Adults with Physical Disabilities

property_tax.name: Senior School Property Tax Credit
property_tax.blurb: Up to $500 credit on school property taxes for residents 65+; recently restored to pre-2017 levels.

highlights: DPAP fills Medicare Part D coverage gaps with up to $3,000/year.
Senior school property tax credit ($500).
Diamond State Health Plan-Plus integrates LTSS with managed care.

FL.name: Florida

dept_aging.name: Florida Department of Elder Affairs

property_tax.name: Senior Homestead Exemption (additional $50K)
property_tax.blurb: Homestead exemption already exempts $50K. Counties may add an extra $50K exemption for owners 65+ with household income under ~$36,614 (2026, indexed annually). Some long-term residents (25+ years) get full exemption.

highlights: No state income tax (relevant for retirees living on Social Security + pension).
SMMC Long-Term Care managed care — single point of contact for LTSS.
Aging and Disability Resource Centers (ADRCs) in every county for triage.

GA.name: Georgia

dept_aging.name: Georgia Division of Aging Services

property_tax.name: School Property Tax Exemption (Age 62+)
property_tax.blurb: Statewide school tax exemption for owners 62+ with income under $10K (state law). Many counties (Fulton, DeKalb, Cobb, Gwinnett) offer their own much more generous senior school tax exemptions — full exemption common at 65+.

highlights: Generous county-level school tax exemptions for seniors (varies — check your county tax assessor).
Elderly & Disabled Waiver Program (EDWP) — Medicaid HCBS.
GeorgiaCares = state SHIP.

HI.name: Hawaii

dept_aging.name: Hawaii Executive Office on Aging

property_tax.name: Multiple Home Exemption (Age-Tiered)
property_tax.blurb: Owner-occupant exemption tiered by age: standard amount under 60, larger at 60–69, larger still at 70+. Set by each county (Honolulu most generous).

highlights: Kupuna Care — state-funded services for 60+ regardless of Medicaid eligibility.
Going Home Plus waiver helps people move from nursing homes back to community.
Sage PLUS = state SHIP.

ID.name: Idaho

dept_aging.name: Idaho Commission on Aging

property_tax.name: Property Tax Reduction ("Circuit Breaker")
property_tax.blurb: Reduces property tax up to $1,500 for owners 65+ (or widowed/disabled) with income under ~$37,000.

highlights: Property Tax Reduction up to $1,500 (Circuit Breaker).
Aged & Disabled (A&D) Waiver covers HCBS.
Senior Health Insurance Benefits Advisors (SHIBA) = state SHIP.

IL.name: Illinois

dept_aging.name: Illinois Department on Aging

spap.name: Illinois Rx Buying Club + Pharmaceutical Assistance

property_tax.name: Senior Citizen Homestead Exemption + Senior Freeze
property_tax.blurb: Senior Homestead Exemption ($8,000 off equalized assessed value at 65+). Senior Freeze (Senior Citizens Assessment Freeze) locks in assessed value for those 65+ with income under $65,000.

highlights: Senior Citizens Assessment Freeze — locks property tax base.
Community Care Program (CCP) = Illinois HCBS.
Aging well into the Older Americans Act framework — strong AAA system.

IN.name: Indiana

dept_aging.name: Indiana Division of Aging

property_tax.name: Over-65 Deduction + Circuit Breaker Cap
property_tax.blurb: $14,000 deduction off assessed value at 65+ with income under $30,000 single / $40,000 combined. Owners 65+ also have property tax capped at 2% of assessed value (vs. 1% standard cap).

highlights: HoosierRx supplements Medicare Part D up to $1,000/year.
Indiana CHOICE waiver for HCBS.
65+ property tax cap of 2% (Circuit Breaker).

IA.name: Iowa

dept_aging.name: Iowa Department of Health and Human Services — Aging

property_tax.name: Disabled and Senior Citizen Property Tax Credit
property_tax.blurb: Sliding-scale credit for owners 65+ with household income under ~$25,000.

highlights: Elderly Waiver — HCBS for Iowa Medicaid.
Iowa SHIIP = state SHIP.
LIFE program (Living Independently for Elders) = state version of PACE in some areas.

KS.name: Kansas

dept_aging.name: Kansas Department for Aging and Disability Services

property_tax.name: Homestead Refund + Senior "SAFESR"
property_tax.blurb: Homestead Refund up to $700 for income-eligible. SAFESR (Senior or Disabled Veterans) refunds 75% of property tax for owners 65+ with income under $23,700.

highlights: SAFESR refunds 75% of property tax for income-eligible 65+.
Frail Elderly (FE) Medicaid waiver = HCBS.
Senior Health Insurance Counseling for Kansas (SHICK) = state SHIP.

KY.name: Kentucky

dept_aging.name: Kentucky Department for Aging and Independent Living

property_tax.name: Homestead Exemption (Age 65+)
property_tax.blurb: Reduces taxable value by ~$49,100 (indexed every 2 years) for owners 65+ regardless of income.

highlights: Homestead exemption regardless of income at 65+.
Home and Community Based (HCB) waiver.
State Health Insurance Assistance Program (SHIP) via DAIL.

LA.name: Louisiana

dept_aging.name: Louisiana Governor's Office of Elderly Affairs

property_tax.name: Senior Special Assessment Level ("Freeze")
property_tax.blurb: Freezes assessed value for owners 65+ with income under ~$100K.

highlights: Senior assessment freeze with very generous income limit.
Community Choices Waiver = HCBS.
Senior Health Insurance Information Program (SHIIP) = state SHIP.

ME.name: Maine

dept_aging.name: Maine Office of Aging and Disability Services

spap.name: Drugs for the Elderly and Disabled (DEL)

property_tax.name: Property Tax Stabilization for Senior Citizens (eligible filers)
property_tax.blurb: Owners 65+ can stabilize (freeze) property tax at the prior-year amount; must be applied for annually. 2024 reform tightened income limits.

highlights: Property tax stabilization for 65+.
Most generous Medicare Savings Program limits in the country.
MaineCare HCBS waivers (Section 19 / 21).

MD.name: Maryland

dept_aging.name: Maryland Department of Aging

spap.name: Maryland Senior Prescription Drug Assistance Program (SPDAP)

property_tax.name: Homeowners' Property Tax Credit + Senior Tax Credit
property_tax.blurb: Statewide Homeowners' Property Tax Credit caps tax based on income. Many counties (Baltimore, Howard, Montgomery, Prince George's) offer additional senior credits.

highlights: SPDAP supplements Medicare Part D.
Community Options Waiver = HCBS.
Senior Care Subsidy program covers in-home services for 65+ not on Medicaid.

MA.name: Massachusetts

dept_aging.name: Massachusetts Executive Office of Elder Affairs

property_tax.name: Senior Circuit Breaker Tax Credit + Clause 41C Exemption
property_tax.blurb: State Circuit Breaker refundable income-tax credit (up to $2,730) for renters and homeowners 65+ paying high property taxes/rent. Cities/towns can adopt local senior exemptions.

highlights: Senior Circuit Breaker — up to $2,730 refundable income-tax credit.
Frail Elder Waiver = HCBS.
Strong PACE network.

MI.name: Michigan

dept_aging.name: Michigan Aging and Adult Services Agency

property_tax.name: Homestead Property Tax Credit + Principal Residence Exemption
property_tax.blurb: Homestead Property Tax Credit (up to $1,800) for income-eligible homeowners and renters; senior-tier amount higher than non-senior. Principal Residence Exemption removes school operating millage.

highlights: MI Choice Waiver — HCBS that includes assisted living.
MMAP (Michigan Medicare/Medicaid Assistance Program) = state SHIP.
Homestead Property Tax Credit up to $1,800.

MN.name: Minnesota

dept_aging.name: Minnesota Board on Aging

property_tax.name: Senior Citizens Property Tax Deferral + Property Tax Refund
property_tax.blurb: Property Tax Deferral lets seniors 65+ defer tax above 3% of household income (state pays, lien). Property Tax Refund (Circuit Breaker) is sliding-scale by income.

highlights: Property Tax Deferral keeps you in your home with capped out-of-pocket.
Elderly Waiver — HCBS.
Minnesota Senior Health Options (MSHO) integrates Medicare + Medicaid for dual-eligibles.

MS.name: Mississippi

dept_aging.name: Mississippi Division of Aging and Adult Services

property_tax.name: Homestead Exemption (Age 65+ / Disabled)
property_tax.blurb: Owners 65+ exempt from up to $7,500 of assessed value (about $75K market value) — total exemption from county and school millage on that portion.

highlights: Homestead exemption for 65+ (no income test).
Independent Living (IL) Waiver = HCBS.
Mississippi Insurance Department SHIP.

MO.name: Missouri

dept_aging.name: Missouri Department of Health and Senior Services

property_tax.name: Senior Citizen Property Tax Credit ("Circuit Breaker") + County Senior Freeze
property_tax.blurb: Statewide "Circuit Breaker" gives up to $750 credit (renters) or $1,100 (owners) at 65+. SB 190 (effective 2024) authorized counties to freeze senior property tax — adoption is county-by-county.

highlights: County senior freeze rolling out statewide post-SB 190 — check your county.
Circuit Breaker Property Tax Credit up to $1,100.
MO Choices for Independence (CFI) waiver.

MT.name: Montana

dept_aging.name: Montana Senior and Long-Term Care Division

property_tax.name: Property Tax Assistance + Elderly Homeowner Credit
property_tax.blurb: Property Tax Assistance reduces tax for owners with income under $25,750 (single) / $34,250 (joint). Elderly Homeowner/Renter Credit is a separate refundable income-tax credit up to $1,150 at 62+.

highlights: Big Sky Rx pays Medicare Part D premium for income-eligible.
Elderly Homeowner/Renter Credit up to $1,150.
Big Sky Waiver = HCBS.

NE.name: Nebraska

dept_aging.name: Nebraska State Unit on Aging

property_tax.name: Homestead Exemption
property_tax.blurb: Owners 65+ (or disabled) exempt from a portion of assessed value, sliding scale by income. 2026 income cap around $46,800 (single).

highlights: Homestead exemption sliding-scale by income.
Aged & Disabled Waiver — HCBS.
Nebraska SHIP through SUA.

NV.name: Nevada

dept_aging.name: Nevada Aging and Disability Services Division

property_tax.name: Senior Property Tax Rebate (limited)
property_tax.blurb: Nevada has no statewide senior freeze. Renters 62+ with very low income may qualify for the Senior Citizens' Property Tax Assistance / Rental Rebate program (funding-dependent).

highlights: Senior Rx + Disability Rx programs supplement Medicare Part D.
No state income tax (relevant for retirees).
HCBW (Home and Community-Based Waiver) for Frail Elderly.

NH.name: New Hampshire

dept_aging.name: New Hampshire Bureau of Elderly and Adult Services

property_tax.name: Elderly Property Tax Exemption
property_tax.blurb: State law authorizes towns to grant elderly exemption — amount varies by town, tiered by age band (65–74, 75–79, 80+).

highlights: Town-by-town elderly exemption — check your town's tax assessor.
Choices for Independence (CFI) waiver — HCBS.
ServiceLink Aging and Disability Resource Center in every county.

NJ.name: New Jersey

dept_aging.name: New Jersey Division of Aging Services

property_tax.name: Senior Freeze (Property Tax Reimbursement) + ANCHOR + Stay NJ
property_tax.blurb: Senior Freeze reimburses property tax increases for owners 65+ with income under ~$170K (2026, indexed). ANCHOR adds a separate property tax rebate. Stay NJ (rolling out 2026) caps senior property tax at 50% of bill.

highlights: Stay NJ caps senior property tax at 50% (rolling out 2026).
PAAD + Senior Gold supplement Medicare Part D substantially.
MLTSS — managed long-term services and supports.

NM.name: New Mexico

dept_aging.name: New Mexico Aging and Long-Term Services Department

property_tax.name: Property Tax Limitation (Valuation Freeze) for Seniors
property_tax.blurb: Owners 65+ with income under $42,900 (2026) can freeze valuation. Plus a low-income property tax rebate for those 65+ with income under $16K.

highlights: Valuation freeze at 65+ with income test.
Centennial Care 2.0 — managed Medicaid LTSS.
BenefitsCal-style central application via YESNM portal.

NY.name: New York

dept_aging.name: New York State Office for the Aging

property_tax.name: Enhanced STAR + Senior Citizens Exemption
property_tax.blurb: Enhanced STAR exempts ~$84,000 of assessed value from school taxes for owners 65+ with income under ~$107K (2026). Local Senior Citizens Exemption ("RP-467") reduces 50% of value for income under ~$58,400 — county adopted.

highlights: EPIC supplements Medicare Part D very generously.
Most generous Medicare Savings Program limits with NYS.
Managed Long Term Care (MLTC) statewide.
Enhanced STAR — major school tax break.

NC.name: North Carolina

dept_aging.name: NC Division of Aging and Adult Services

property_tax.name: Elderly or Disabled Homestead Exclusion + Circuit Breaker
property_tax.blurb: Elderly Homestead Exclusion exempts $25,000 or 50% of value (whichever greater) for owners 65+ with income under $37,900 (2026). Circuit Breaker caps tax at 4–5% of income for 65+ with income under $56,850.

highlights: Choice of Homestead Exclusion or Circuit Breaker — pick whichever's better.
CAP/DA waiver — HCBS.
Senior Health Insurance Information Program (SHIIP) = state SHIP.

ND.name: North Dakota

dept_aging.name: North Dakota Aging Services Division

property_tax.name: Homestead Property Tax Credit
property_tax.blurb: Owners 65+ with income under $42,000 get sliding-scale exemption; up to 100% reduction for the lowest income tier.

highlights: Homestead Credit can wipe out 100% of property tax for low-income 65+.
Service Payments for Elderly and Disabled (SPED) — state-funded HCBS.
Aging Services Division SHIP.

OH.name: Ohio

dept_aging.name: Ohio Department of Aging

property_tax.name: Homestead Exemption (Age 65+)
property_tax.blurb: Reduces taxable value by $26,200 for owners 65+ with income under $39,800 (2026). Disabled veterans get larger exemption regardless of income.

highlights: PASSPORT waiver — HCBS, very large enrollment.
Homestead exemption for 65+ (income tested).
Ohio Senior Health Insurance Information Program (OSHIIP).

OK.name: Oklahoma

dept_aging.name: Oklahoma Human Services — Aging Services

property_tax.name: Senior Valuation Limitation ("Senior Freeze")
property_tax.blurb: Owners 65+ can freeze fair cash value for ad valorem purposes if income is under HUD median for the county (varies — typically $74K–$94K). Additional Senior Citizen Sales Tax Relief credit available.

highlights: Senior valuation freeze — generous income limits.
Living Choice waiver — HCBS.
Senior Health Insurance Counseling Program (SHIP).

OR.name: Oregon

dept_aging.name: Oregon Department of Human Services — Aging and People with Disabilities

property_tax.name: Senior and Disabled Property Tax Deferral
property_tax.blurb: Defers all or part of property tax for owners 62+ with income under $59,500 (2026). State pays the county; lien on property until sale or death.

highlights: Senior Property Tax Deferral — no payment due during your lifetime.
Oregon Project Independence — state-funded in-home services.
K Plan (1915(k) State Plan) covers attendant care.

PA.name: Pennsylvania

dept_aging.name: Pennsylvania Department of Aging

property_tax.name: Property Tax/Rent Rebate Program
property_tax.blurb: Statewide rebate up to $1,000 for owners and renters 65+ (or widowed 50+) with income under $46,520 (expanded substantially in 2024).

highlights: PACE / PACENET — among the most generous SPAPs nationally.
Property Tax/Rent Rebate up to $1,000 (2024 expansion).
Community HealthChoices — managed LTSS.

RI.name: Rhode Island

dept_aging.name: Rhode Island Office of Healthy Aging

property_tax.name: Property Tax Relief Credit
property_tax.blurb: Refundable state income tax credit for owners 65+ (or disabled) with income under $36,000. Many cities/towns offer additional senior exemptions.

highlights: RIPAE supplements Part D for moderate-income seniors.
Co-Pay Program covers in-home services for non-Medicaid 65+.
ICI (Independent Provider) HCBS option.

SC.name: South Carolina

dept_aging.name: South Carolina Department on Aging

property_tax.name: Homestead Exemption (Age 65+)
property_tax.blurb: First $50,000 of fair market value exempt for owners 65+ regardless of income. Plus the 4% legal-residence assessment ratio (vs. 6% non-owner-occupied).

highlights: Homestead exemption at 65+ with no income test.
Community Choices Waiver — HCBS.
Insurance Counseling Assistance and Referrals for Elders (I-CARE) = state SHIP.

SD.name: South Dakota

dept_aging.name: South Dakota Department of Human Services — Adult Services and Aging

property_tax.name: Property Tax Reduction for Elderly + Assessment Freeze
property_tax.blurb: Sliding-scale property tax reduction for owners 65+ with income under $35,962 (2026). Separate Assessment Freeze for owners 65+ with income under $36,500.

highlights: Both a property tax reduction AND assessment freeze available.
HOPE waiver — HCBS.
No state income tax (relevant for retirees).

TN.name: Tennessee

dept_aging.name: Tennessee Commission on Aging and Disability

property_tax.name: Property Tax Relief + Property Tax Freeze
property_tax.blurb: Property Tax Relief reimburses up to a state-set portion for owners 65+ with income under $36,370 (2026). Property Tax Freeze (county-adopted) locks in tax for owners 65+ with income under varying county-set caps.

highlights: Both Property Tax Relief and county-level Property Tax Freeze.
CHOICES program — managed LTSS.
No state income tax on wages or pensions.

TX.name: Texas

dept_aging.name: Texas Health and Human Services — Aging Services

property_tax.name: Over-65 Homestead Exemption + School Tax Ceiling
property_tax.blurb: Owners 65+ get an additional $10K homestead exemption on school district taxes (on top of standard $100K). School tax bill is permanently frozen at the amount due in the year you turned 65 ("tax ceiling"). Counties may add their own senior exemptions.

highlights: School tax ceiling at 65 — locks in your school tax forever.
STAR+PLUS — managed LTSS.
No state income tax.

UT.name: Utah

dept_aging.name: Utah Division of Aging and Adult Services

property_tax.name: Circuit Breaker (Renter Refund + Homeowner's Credit)
property_tax.blurb: Owners 66+ with income under $40,840 (2026) get a sliding-scale credit up to $1,259. Renters 65+ with similar income limits get a separate refund.

highlights: Circuit Breaker credit up to $1,259.
Aging Waiver — HCBS.
SHIP under DAAS.

VT.name: Vermont

dept_aging.name: Vermont Department of Disabilities, Aging and Independent Living

property_tax.name: Renter Credit + Homestead Property Tax Credit
property_tax.blurb: Both renters and homeowners can claim income-based property tax credits — sliding scale, age-neutral but very generous for fixed-income retirees.

highlights: VPharm covers Medicare Part D premiums up to set limits.
Choices for Care (1115 waiver) integrates LTSS.
Strong AAA system (5 regions covering all 14 counties).

VA.name: Virginia

dept_aging.name: Virginia Department for Aging and Rehabilitative Services

property_tax.name: Real Estate Tax Relief / Exemption (Local)
property_tax.blurb: Virginia delegates senior property tax relief to localities. Most cities/counties offer significant exemption or freeze for owners 65+ with income/asset limits set locally (e.g., Fairfax allows up to 100% exemption for income under ~$60K).

highlights: Local senior property tax programs — check your county/city.
Commonwealth Coordinated Care Plus (CCC Plus) — managed LTSS.
Virginia Insurance Counseling and Assistance Program (VICAP) = SHIP.

WA.name: Washington

dept_aging.name: Washington State Department of Social and Health Services — Aging and Long-Term Support

property_tax.name: Senior Property Tax Exemption + Deferral
property_tax.blurb: Property Tax Exemption reduces value by sliding-scale amount for owners 61+ with income under $66,000 (county-indexed). Property Tax Deferral lets seniors defer up to 80% of taxes (state pays, lien on property).

highlights: Long-term care payroll tax (WA Cares Fund) launching benefits in 2026 — first state-run LTC insurance.
COPES Waiver — HCBS.
Senior exemption income limit indexed to county median (very generous in King/Snohomish).

WV.name: West Virginia

dept_aging.name: West Virginia Bureau of Senior Services

property_tax.name: Senior Citizen Tax Credit + Homestead Exemption
property_tax.blurb: $20,000 homestead exemption for owners 65+ (or totally disabled) regardless of income. Senior Citizen Tax Credit for income under federal poverty limit.

highlights: Homestead exemption ($20K) regardless of income at 65+.
Aged & Disabled Waiver — HCBS.
Family Alzheimer's In-Home Respite (FAIR) program.

WI.name: Wisconsin

dept_aging.name: Wisconsin Department of Health Services — Aging Programs

property_tax.name: Homestead Credit
property_tax.blurb: Refundable income-tax credit for owners and renters with household income under $24,680 (single, 2026). Substantially boosted for elderly/disabled.

highlights: SeniorCare — drug coverage at $30/year deductible (cheapest SPAP in country).
Family Care + IRIS — Wisconsin's two HCBS options.
Strong PACE coverage in Milwaukee + Madison.

WY.name: Wyoming

dept_aging.name: Wyoming Department of Health — Aging Division

property_tax.name: Property Tax Refund Program
property_tax.blurb: Statewide refund for residents with household income under specified thresholds. 2024–2025 Long-Term Homeowner Exemption added a 50% exemption for owners 65+ who've lived in WY 25+ years.

highlights: Long-Term Homeowner exemption (50%) for 65+ with 25+ year residency.
Community Choices Waiver — HCBS.
No state income tax.

DC.name: District of Columbia

dept_aging.name: DC Department of Aging and Community Living

property_tax.name: Senior Citizen / Disabled Property Tax Relief
property_tax.blurb: 50% reduction in real property tax for homeowners 65+ with income under $174,600 (2026, very generous in DC). Plus property tax deferral options.

highlights: 50% senior property tax reduction with high income ceiling.
EPD (Elderly and Persons with Physical Disabilities) Waiver — HCBS.
Senior Service Network — single point of triage via DACL.
